text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Members of the gay and lesbian community in Namibia are demanding an apology from President Sam Nujoma and the ruling SWAPO party, after recent verbal attacks against homosexuals by the SWAPO information office. They also plan to refer the matter to the Office of the ombudsman.
- A group representing Namibia's gay and lesbian community wants the newly appointed ombudsman to clarify their position in society.
- The Interior Ministry is looking for new ways to deport illegal immigrants from Namibia. An official from for immigration and border control said the present system ws too costly.
